source.title: Alna - Frozen Mother
source.name: Alna
source.description: A stalwart Tank who summons swirling snowstorms to shield allies from incoming damage.

skills.name: Winter Anthem

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Alna blankets the battlefield in frost, reducing Haste by 40 and range by 2 tiles for all units except herself. Active. Alna lets out a battle cry and summons a blizzard, which removes the Haste buffs from all enemies and deals 40% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) damage to each enemy every 0.5s for 8s. While the blizzard is active, when Alna or the Winter Warrior takes damage, they recover 50% + 5% (SP-based) of the HP lost from that damage over the next 10s.

skills.description_lite: Alna summons a blizzard to reduce enemies' Haste and deal damage over time.

skills.name: Shared Resolve

description.raw: During battle preparation, Alna selects an ally placed in the same row as herself to become the Winter Warrior. That ally is immune to Winter Anthem's Haste reduction effect, and their max HP is permanently increased by 15% + 1.5% (SP-based). Active. Alna thrusts her spear to deal 340% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage to enemies, restoring 100% + 10% (SP-based) HP to herself and the Winter Warrior.

skills.name: Wild Whirl

description.raw: Alna repeatedly swings her spear, striking enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of her twice, with each hit dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage. She then sweeps her spear around, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all surrounding enemies and reducing their Haste by 50 for 8s.

skills.name: Chilling Presence

description.raw: When a battle starts and every 20s thereafter, Alna envelops herself in icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects for 4s.
active: When a battle starts and every 20s thereafter, Alna envelops herself in icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects for 4s.

text: Extends this skill's damage and control immunity to 5s.

After casting Chilling Presence, Alna also grants the Winter Warrior the same immunity effects.
The first time either Alna's or the Winter Warrior's HP drops bellow 50% in battle, Chilling Presence triggers automatically for both.
This effect can only be triggered 1 time per hero per battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a 15% increase to their basic stats until one of them is defeated. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warior will freeze enemies within 1 tile for 2s and reduce those enemies' Vitality by 50 for 10s.
